description: VR mod for SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE (Steam): play it in a SteamVR headset with motion controllers, hands and grab-and-throw.
notes: SHMCD-VR is installed into your SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE folder (found through Steam), with BepInEx 5 (x86).
Needs Python 3 once, to switch VR on in the game data (the UnityPy package is installed with pip). Originals are kept as *.orig.
Start SteamVR, then the game. Optional: 'SHMCD-VR - Add to Steam' in the Start menu adds a 'SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE VR' entry to Steam and SteamVR with artwork (closes and restarts Steam).
Game in an unusual place? Set the SHMCDVR_GAMEDIR environment variable to its folder and install again.

script: # 1. Find the game: SHMCDVR_GAMEDIR, or the Steam libraries.
if (-not $gd) { throw 'SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE not found. Set the SHMCDVR_GAMEDIR environment variable to the folder with SHMCD.exe and install again.' }
# 3. Start menu helper: adds the Steam / SteamVR entry with artwork.

Set-Content "$dir\Add to Steam.bat" -Encoding ASCII -Value @('@echo off', "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ""%~dp0steam-entry\add-steam-vr-shortcut.ps1"" -GameDir ""$gd"" -BuildDir ""%~dp0steam-entry""", 'pause')
# On update the new version installs over the old one; only a real uninstall removes the mod.
